D/ DN VALENS PFAVG ; R/ GLORIA ROMANORVM

A nummus (AE 1 - AE 4) of the House of Valentinian Reece period: 19 [364-378]. Obverse description: Diademed bust right.Obverse inscription: DN VALENS PFAVG. Reverse description: Emperor with standard dragging captive. Reverse inscription: GLORIA ROMANORVM
